title: YueWang996/bard-pytorch-dynamics
abstract:
bard is a lightweight, PyTorch-native library for rigid-body dynamics that leverages tensor operations to perform efficient, batched computations on either the CPU or GPU. It provides a simple yet powerful API for loading robots from URDF files and analyzing their motion using standard robotics algorithms.

# bard: Batched Articulated Robot Dynamics [ ](https://github.com/YueWang996/bard/actions) [ ](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) [ ](https://github.com/YueWang996/bard) [ ](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31481) `bard` is a lightweight, PyTorch-native library for rigid-body dynamics that leverages tensor operations to perform efficient, batched computations on either the CPU or GPU. It provides a simple yet powerful API for loading robots from URDF files and analyzing their motion using standard robotics algorithms. The primary motivation behind `bard` is to provide a dynamics library that integrates seamlessly into modern machine learning workflows. By treating the robot's state and dynamics as a differentiable computation graph, it becomes an ideal tool for robotics research in areas like reinforcement learning, trajectory optimization, physics-informed learning, and system identification. ## Feature Comparison ✨ `bard` combines the best of both worlds: native PyTorch integration for ML workflows and comprehensive robotics algorithms. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：bard 是一个 PyTorch 原生的轻量级刚体动力学库：把机器人状态与动力学建模为可微计算图，基于张量运算在 CPU/GPU 上做批量计算，提供 URDF 加载以及正向运动学、雅可比、逆动力学（RNEA）、正动力学（ABA）、质量矩阵（CRBA）等标准算法的简洁 API。


# 一、动机

> 传统刚体动力学库（Pinocchio、RBDL）不是 PyTorch 原生，缺乏批处理、GPU 加速与自动微分，难以直接嵌入现代机器学习流水线；而 pytorch_kinematics 虽为 PyTorch 实现，却不支持浮动基座、逆动力学/正动力学/质量矩阵等核心动力学算法。


# 二、方法

> bard 是一个 PyTorch 原生的轻量级刚体动力学库：把机器人状态与动力学建模为可微计算图，基于张量运算在 CPU/GPU 上做批量计算，提供 URDF 加载以及正向运动学、雅可比、逆动力学（RNEA）、正动力学（ABA）、质量矩阵（CRBA）等标准算法的简洁 API。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 功能对比表显示，bard 是唯一同时具备 PyTorch 原生、批处理、GPU 加速、自动微分与浮动基座支持的库；完整覆盖 FK、Jacobian、RNEA、ABA、CRBA 与 URDF 解析，可支撑上千条并行仿真的神经网络训练；唯一缺口是不支持逆运动学（IK）。论文摘要与 README 未给出与 Pinocchio/RBDL 的精度或速度定量基准。


# 四、对我的启发

> 局限在于缺少 IK、且未提供与成熟 C++ 库的数值精度/吞吐量化对比，小批量下 GPU 与 autograd 开销可能反而更慢；但将动力学完全可微化并批量化，对强化学习、轨迹优化、物理信息学习与系统辨识等具身智能任务很有价值。
